courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 低溫紅外偵測器
related.transfer: 可遷移「熱點形成、偏置電流與脈衝產生」與「系統偵測效率的可溯源校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；低溫紅外偵測器的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Hotspot formation, bias current and pulse generation" and "Traceable calibration of system detection efficiency" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Cryogenic infrared detectors must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦熱點偵測機制、光學腔效率、動態電感重置、暗計數與皮秒時間抖動預算；低溫紅外偵測器則以HgCdTe 混成陣列的截止波長、暗電流、多次取樣讀出與低溫特性化工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on hotspot detection, optical-cavity efficiency, kinetic-inductance reset, dark counts and picosecond timing-jitter budgets; Cryogenic infrared detectors centres on cutoff wavelength, dark current, multi-sample readout and cryogenic characterisation of HgCdTe hybrid arrays, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「偏置中的 NbN 奈米線與熱點」與「窄能隙半導體與截止波長」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到低溫紅外偵測器，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「非線性、持續影像與校正鏈」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Biased NbN nanowire and hotspot” and “Narrow-gap semiconductor and cutoff wavelength”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Cryogenic infrared detectors, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Nonlinearity, persistence and the calibration chain", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 超導奈米線單光子偵測器
history.text: 2001 年 Gol'tsman、Sobolewski 等人以數奈米厚的 NbN 窄條首次展示超導奈米線的單光子偵測；2013 年 NIST 與 JPL 團隊以 WSi 奈米線加光學腔在 1550 nm 達到約 93% 的系統偵測效率。同年 NASA 月球雷射通訊示範的地面站採用 SNSPD 陣列接收機，2023 年 Psyche 任務的深空光通訊實驗也以 SNSPD 陣列在帕洛馬天文台接收雷射訊號。如今 Single Quantum、ID Quantique 等公司提供多通道商用系統。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 2001 Gol'tsman, Sobolewski and colleagues first demonstrated single-photon detection with a superconducting strip of few-nanometre NbN; in 2013 a NIST and JPL team reached about 93% system detection efficiency at 1550 nm with WSi nanowires in an optical cavity. The same year the ground terminal of NASA's Lunar Laser Communication Demonstration used SNSPD array receivers, and in 2023 the Deep Space Optical Communications experiment on the Psyche mission received laser signals at Palomar Observatory with an SNSPD array. Companies such as Single Quantum and ID Quantique now supply multichannel commercial systems. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「熱點形成、偏置電流與脈衝產生」到「系統驗收、操作點選擇與交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Hotspot formation, bias current and pulse generation" through "System acceptance, operating-point choice and handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
